code_prompt_defaults.json_output_contract: Return one JSON object with keys "answer" and "annotation".
code_prompt_defaults.json_output_contract_answer_only: Return one JSON object with key "answer".
code_prompt_defaults.object_description_bearing: station labels, north arrows, a known bearing, and one bearing marked ?
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_bearing: set "annotation" to a JSON object with keys for the visible witnesses. For back-bearing questions, use exactly "station_a", "station_b", "reference_north", and "target_direction". For traverse-turn questions, use those keys plus "turn_vertex". Each value must be the pixel point [x,y] at that station, north reference, target bearing ray, or turn vertex
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_bearing_from_back_bearin: set "annotation" to a JSON object with exactly these keys: "station_a", "station_b", "reference_north", and "target_direction"; each value must be the pixel point [x,y] at the visible station, north reference, or target bearing ray
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_closed_traverse_missing_: set "annotation" to a JSON object with exactly these keys: "station_a", "station_b", "reference_north", "target_direction", and "turn_vertex"; each value must be the pixel point [x,y] at the visible station, north reference, target bearing ray, or turn vertex
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_bearing: set "answer" to the marked survey bearing as an integer number of degrees clockwise from north
code_prompt_defaults.object_description_elevation: station labels, a measurement line or slope segment, a field note, and one elevation marked ?
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_elevation: set "annotation" to a JSON object with exactly these keys: "reference_station", "target_station", "measurement_line", and "field_note_region"; each value must be the pixel point [x,y] at that station, line midpoint, or note center
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_elevation: set "answer" to the missing station elevation as an integer value in the same units shown
code_prompt_defaults.object_description_area: station labels, an enclosed traverse or offset shape, a field note, and the area marked ?
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_area: set "annotation" to a JSON object with exactly these keys: "traverse_region", "field_note_region", and "area_reference_region". Each value must be the pixel bounding box [x0,y0,x1,y1] around the traverse or offset shape, the field-note table, or the coordinate axes/baseline reference
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_area: set "answer" to the marked survey area as an integer number of square units
